headline: Executive order directs federal agencies to carry out a cost-cutting effort tied to the Department of Government Efficiency (DOGE).
what_it_does: This order sets out steps for federal agencies to put in place a cost efficiency initiative connected to the Department of Government Efficiency. Based on the title alone, it appears aimed at reducing how much federal agencies spend. No summary was provided, so the specific rules, spending areas, and deadlines are not described here.

who_it_affects.how: Agencies are directed to carry out the cost efficiency initiative, which may change how they review and approve spending.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed February 26, 2025; specific effective dates were not provided in the source material.
